notes: Supports SI1 through active management of fishing pressure on marine ecosystems, the main lever Wales has over marine ecosystem condition. Surfaced by the new marine_coastal cluster. Read alongside the expired MPA management framework: fisheries management is progressing while the protected-area framework it sits inside is out of date.
summary: A written statement of 29 January 2026 reports progress on the Strategic Approach to Welsh Fisheries and Aquaculture since December 2024: the King Scallop Fisheries Management Plan consultation has closed, a Wales-only crab and lobster plan consultation is due to launch, the Welsh Marine and Fisheries Scheme opened its sixth round on 7 January with an increased budget, 194,000 pounds has gone to inshore vessel monitoring systems, and multi-year science contracts and a carbon audit of the Welsh fleet have been commissioned.
title: Welsh fisheries and aquaculture update reports progress on management plans and fleet decarbonisation
